title: Ship a phoenix-cli agent skill (SKILL.md) that teaches shell agents the CLI contract
outcome: Shell-only agents get the same agent-first guidance MCP hosts receive at initialize, without a second source of truth for tool parameters
acceptance: skills/phoenix-cli/SKILL.md exists with Agent Skills frontmatter (name, description); it covers only contract: workspace-root precedence, discovery verbs (tools/help/schema, offline, no daemon), invocation grammar (--param, --flag/--flag=false, --json, --args-file path|-, --pretty, exact camelCase wire names, reserved names), one-JSON-document stdout, exit codes 0/1/2/3/130, error ids and retryable vs retryRecommended/retryHint, daemon_request_rejected re-run-once, cold start via server_capabilities index.state/progress, and the same tool-routing order as the MCP server instructions; it lists no tool parameters (phoenix help <tool> is the source of truth); README documents installation for Claude Code, Copilot, and Codex; no tests (docs), reviewed by the dual review as docs

completion.summary: Shipped and committed the repository-installable Phoenix CLI skill template, build/publish distribution link, exact README installation workflow, canonical agent boundary/routing guidance, and the full-suite-derived Git convergence regression fix.
